// Command wiregold writes seglog/testdata/wire_golden.json and
// wire_edge.bin.gz with Pebble's own record.Writer, so that seglog's tests
// can check its segment format against Pebble without depending on it.
//
// It runs in a scratch module whose go.mod requires
// github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/v2 v2.1.7:
//
//	go run . /path/to/raftseg/seglog/testdata
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/v2/record"
)

const (
	blockSize       = 32 << 10
	chunkHeaderSize = 7
)

// payloadSizes and makePayloads are copied verbatim from seglog/wire_test.go.
func payloadSizes(rng *rand.Rand, n int) []int {
	sizes := []int{0, 1, blockSize - 2*chunkHeaderSize, blockSize - chunkHeaderSize - 3, 0, 70 << 10, 5}
	for len(sizes) < n {
		switch rng.Intn(4) {
		case 0:
			sizes = append(sizes, rng.Intn(100))
		case 1:
			sizes = append(sizes, rng.Intn(blockSize))
		case 2:
			sizes = append(sizes, rng.Intn(3*blockSize))
		default:
			sizes = append(sizes, blockSize-chunkHeaderSize-rng.Intn(16))
		}
	}
	return sizes
}

func makePayloads(rng *rand.Rand, sizes []int) [][]byte {
	out := make([][]byte, len(sizes))
	for i, n := range sizes {
		out[i] = make([]byte, n)
		rng.Read(out[i])
	}
	return out
}

// edgePayload is the content of record i of the edge stream.
func edgePayload(i, n int) []byte { return bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(i + 1)}, n) }

type stream struct {
	Seed   int64   `json:"seed,omitempty"`
	N      int     `json:"n,omitempty"`
	Sizes  []int   `json:"sizes,omitempty"`
	Ends   []int64 `json:"ends"`
	Size   int     `json:"size"`
	SHA256 string  `json:"sha256"`
}

func write(payloads [][]byte) (stream, []byte) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	w := record.NewWriter(&buf)
	var s stream
	for i, p := range payloads {
		end, err := w.WriteRecord(p)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		s.Ends = append(s.Ends, end)
		if i%17 == 0 {
			if err := w.Flush(); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	// Pebble's own reader must read it back.
	r := record.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()), 0)
	for i, want := range payloads {
		rr, err := r.Next()
		if err != nil {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("record %d: %v", i, err))
		}
		got, err := io.ReadAll(rr)
		if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("record %d differs", i))
		}
	}
	if _, err := r.Next(); err != io.EOF {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("trailing record: %v", err))
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(buf.Bytes())
	s.Size = buf.Len()
	s.SHA256 = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	return s, buf.Bytes()
}

// edgeSizes places record starts at every offset within 12 bytes of a block
// end, and then writes records of 0, 1 and 2 bytes and records that end
// exactly on a block boundary, span one boundary, or span several.
func edgeSizes() []int {
	var sizes []int
	pos := 0
	add := func(n int) {
		if rem := blockSize - pos%blockSize; rem < chunkHeaderSize {
			pos += rem
		}
		sizes = append(sizes, n)
		left := n
		for {
			avail := blockSize - pos%blockSize - chunkHeaderSize
			if left <= avail {
				pos += chunkHeaderSize + left
				return
			}
			pos += chunkHeaderSize + avail
			left -= avail
		}
	}
	for _, follow := range []int{0, 1, 2, 100, blockSize - chunkHeaderSize, blockSize, 2*blockSize + 5} {
		for gap := 0; gap <= 12; gap++ {
			// A record that leaves exactly gap bytes in the block it ends in.
			rem := blockSize - pos%blockSize
			if rem < chunkHeaderSize {
				rem = blockSize // the next record starts in the next block
			}
			n := rem - chunkHeaderSize - gap
			if n < 0 {
				n = rem - 2*chunkHeaderSize - gap + blockSize
			}
			add(n)
			if got := (blockSize - pos%blockSize) % blockSize; got != gap {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("gap %d: %d bytes left", gap, got))
			}
			add(follow)
		}
	}
	return sizes
}

func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	out := struct {
		Generator string   `json:"generator"`
		Random    []stream `json:"random"`
		Edge      stream   `json:"edge"`
	}{Generator: "github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/v2 v2.1.7 record.Writer (legacy chunks)"}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		seed int64
		n    int
	}{{1, 300}, {2, 300}, {3, 200}, {4, 100}, {5, 100}, {6, 100}, {7, 100}, {8, 100}} {
		rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(c.seed))
		s, _ := write(makePayloads(rng, payloadSizes(rng, c.n)))
		s.Seed, s.N = c.seed, c.n
		out.Random = append(out.Random, s)
	}
	sizes := edgeSizes()
	payloads := make([][]byte, len(sizes))
	for i, n := range sizes {
		payloads[i] = edgePayload(i, n)
	}
	edge, data := write(payloads)
	edge.Sizes = sizes
	out.Edge = edge

	j, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "wire_golden.json"), append(j, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var gz bytes.Buffer
	zw, _ := gzip.NewWriterLevel(&gz, gzip.BestCompression)
	zw.Write(data)
	zw.Close()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "wire_edge.bin.gz"), gz.Bytes(), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%d random streams, edge stream of %d records (%d bytes, %d gzipped)\n", len(out.Random), len(sizes), len(data), gz.Len())
}
